name: rules.transfer
purpose: Inspect native configuration through inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: ruleId
fields.meaning: Native row identity, retained without conversion.

limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. Native fields, nested values, exact decimals and unknown fields are retained.
Single GET with fixed rowStart=0, pageSize=5000 and empty debitEntity/creditEntity arrays; no offset fallback.
All native conditions and nested values remain intact. SDK collection reports duplicates and count shortfall as incomplete; strict refresh publishes complete acquisitions only.

The qualified historical request width 5000 is a starting value, not a measured backend maximum. SDK conflict resolution keeps the last arrival and marks coverage incomplete; strict refresh preserves the prior cache on rejection.
